name: Superhuman Go
description: Runs a cross-app assistant with no-code custom agents, an Agent Store, and MCP connectors; developers extend it with the Plugins SDK and connect AI clients via Superhuman Mail MCP.

skills.name: Custom Agents
skills.description: Builds agents in the Go agent builder that run on a schedule, while the user types, or when an email or Slack message arrives.

skills.name: Agent Store
skills.description: Adds ready-made agents from Superhuman and partners for tasks such as schoolwork, sales, and accounting.

skills.name: MCP Connectors
skills.description: Grounds Go's answers and actions in the user's apps through pre-built or custom MCP connectors.

skills.name: Plugins SDK
skills.description: Builds connectors with formulas, actions, indexed sync tables, and skills that Go's LLM can call, using @superhuman/plugins-sdk.

skills.name: Superhuman Mail MCP
skills.description: Lets Claude, ChatGPT, and other MCP clients search, draft, and send email across connected Gmail and Outlook inboxes, with approval before sending.
